# Nick Salazar
> Independent marine surveyor and cargo consultant. Second Mate Unlimited · 1600-Ton Master.

## Who
Nick Salazar is a non-biased, independent marine surveyor and cargo consultant with a decade surveying cargo including break bulk, heavy lift and project cargo, steel, containers, draft, towing, loading, railcar, truck, jack and slide, airfreight and packing.
